findings.evidence: `CentralIsogeny/Basic.lean:151` defines `isogenies` by the identical `(@IsFinite ⊓ (@Flat ⊓ @Surjective)).inverseImage ...`; `CentralIsogeny/BaseChange.lean:61-67` proves its base change with the same three `MorphismProperty.overPullbackMap` calls.
findings.fix: Generalize the existing group-scheme finite/flat/surjective property and base-change theorem from fields to the required commutative-ring bases, then use that canonical property/theorem here and delete the private copies.
findings.issue: `isogenyProperty` and `isogenyProperty_pullback` duplicate `GroupScheme.isogenies` and `GroupScheme.IsIsogeny.baseChange` (including the same three `overPullbackMap` applications).

summary: The base-change proof introduces a second copy of the existing group-scheme isogeny property and its pullback proof instead of generalizing and reusing that API.
